title: Columns from two tables in one table each filter their own table
query: EVALUATE FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( CROSSJOIN ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), VALUES ( 'Date'[Year] ) ), "Amt", [Sales Amount] ), [Amt] > 0 )

source.quote: Each column has its own data lineage, even though a table contains columns originating from different tables
source.supports: the article's query: each column keeps its own lineage and both filter the measure

derivation: Red 2023: Sales rows 1, 2, 3 = 100 + 40 + 20 = 160. Red 2024: rows 5, 7 = 200 + 100 = 300. Blue 2023: row 4 = 50. Blue 2024: row 6 = 30. Green has no sales in either year: BLANK is not greater than 0, so those rows are removed. 160 + 300 + 50 + 30 = 540.
